This editorial illustration features a caricature of a man with a dark mustache and side-swept black hair, wearing a gray long-sleeved shirt. He is shown from the chest up, angled slightly to the left but looking back over his shoulder toward the right. His hands are raised in a defensive posture with palms facing outward. From the right edge of the frame, a thick, muscular arm and hand hold a blue gasoline nozzle with a black trigger and hose. The nozzle is pointed directly at the man's back. 

The background is a solid light gray. Above the man is the large red masthead "TEMPO" with the tagline "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU" below it. At the top, black text reads "Dosa Menteri Desa di Pilkada Serang H.28" and "Prospek Bank Emas H.84". Beside the man, bold black text reads "DIA LAGI MEREKA LAGI," followed by a paragraph mentioning "Pertamina," "Rp 193,7 triliun," and "Riza Chalid." The bottom left includes a barcode, QR code, and the date "10-16 MARET 2025."
